db54a5aa0a19cc10.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مجمع عيادات الطبية عن أخصائي تقنية إشعاعية للانضمام إلى فريقه في منطقة الجوف، وتحديداً في مدينتي قرية العليا والقريات. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تجهيز المرضى وإجراء التصوير الإشعاعي، مع ضمان جودة الصور وتوثيقها بشكل دقيق. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد المرضى للتصوير وتهيئتهم وفق الأوضاع الصحيحة، وتحديد واختيار وسائل الحماية المناسبة. تشغيل أجهزة التصوير الشعاعي وتصوير الحالات المختلفة للمرضى والمصابين، ومراقبة حالتهم أثناء وبعد التصوير. فحص وتجهيز أجهزة التحميض، ومراجعة الصور وإجراء التحليل الأولي للتأكد من جودتها. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات في تقنيات التصوير بالأشعة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالتصوير الإشعاعي وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة، بما يتوافق مع السياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة خلال جميع أعمال التصوير بالأشعة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال تقنية الإشعاع. القدرة على تجهيز المرضى والمعدات لإجراء التصوير الإشعاعي. معرفة جيدة بضبط جودة الصور الشعاعية وحفظها وتوثيقها. بيئة العمل يعمل أخصائي تقنية الإشعاع ضمن بيئة عيادات طبية في منطقة الجوف، وتحديداً في قرية العليا والقريات. يتطلب الدور التزاماً بالعمل بدوام كامل لتقديم رعاية صحية عالية الجودة للمرضى. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور في مجمع عيادات الطبية.

dbb0591b1a416786.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مجموعة بن لادن السعودية عن مهندس مدني للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الدمام. يركز هذا الدور على تطوير ومراقبة الجداول الزمنية للمشاريع، بالإضافة إلى تحليل التقدم المحرز والانحرافات والتوقعات لضمان سير العمل بكفاءة وفعالية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد وتحديث الجداول الزمنية للمشاريع بدقة. قياس الإنجاز الفعلي للمشروع ومقارنته بالخطط الموضوعة. تحليل المسار الحرج للمشاريع لتحديد الأنشطة ذات الأولوية وتأثيرها على الجدول الزمني. إعداد التوقعات والتقارير الدورية حول حالة تقدم المشروع. تطوير خطط التعافي لمعالجة أي انحرافات أو تأخيرات محتملة في الجدول الزمني. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال الهندسة المدنية وإدارة المشاريع. فهم عميق لمبادئ تخطيط المشاريع وجدولتها ومراقبتها. القدرة على تحليل البيانات وتقديم تقارير واضحة وموجزة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مجموعة بن لادن السعودية في المنطقة الشرقية، وتحديداً في مدينة الدمام. سيعمل المهندس المدني ضمن بيئة عمل ديناميكية تتطلب الدقة والالتزام بالجداول الزمنية للمشاريع. نوع التوظيف هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وتقدم فرصة للمهندسين المدنيين ذوي الخبرة للمساهمة في مشاريع المجموعة في المنطقة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية التوظيف.

db1e05bf779be6ff.description: About the Role Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a Senior Manager - Cost Planning to join their team in Riyadh, Riyadh Province. This full-time role involves supporting Qiddiya’s cost planning requirements within assigned business units, development projects, and governance activities. The Senior Manager will provide structured cost planning support, coordinate consultants, offer input for Stage Gate reviews, conduct benchmarking analysis, and assist with cost governance to ensure project budgets, cost plans, and design-to-budget decisions are evidence-based and aligned with Qiddiya’s standards. Role Purpose and Context The primary purpose of this role is to support General Business Unit Cost Planning in applying consistent cost planning standards across Qiddiya’s business units and development assets. The Senior Manager will ensure cost planning activities are well-coordinated, consultant outputs are reviewed according to agreed requirements, and Stage Gate submissions include necessary cost planning information. The role operates within the Business Unit cost planning environment, supporting the application of Qiddiya Cost Planning Technical Guidelines, asset class guidelines, processes, benchmarking requirements, and digital tools. While external consultants may prepare detailed cost plans, the Senior Manager is responsible for reviewing outputs, coordinating comments, maintaining records, and escalating key issues to leadership. Key Accountabilities Coordinate cost planning activities for assigned projects, workstreams, business unit support, and development programmes. Support the implementation of Qiddiya Cost Planning Technical Guidelines, asset class guidelines, templates, trackers, reporting standards, and governance processes. Review and comment on cost consultant outputs, including cost plans, reconciliations, assumptions, risk allowances, benchmarks, cost reports, and design-to-budget recommendations. Maintain clear and current cost planning records for assigned projects, workstreams, or business unit support areas. Support Stage Gate reviews by checking cost planning readiness, completeness, compliance, and alignment with required deliverables. Coordinate with business units, development teams, design teams, commercial, procurement, finance, project controls, digital teams, and external consultants to support integrated cost planning outcomes. Support early-stage cost advice, feasibility input, benchmark checks, and pre-concept cost planning before the appointment of project cost consultants. Assist with the briefing, mobilisation, coordination, and performance monitoring of executive and project cost consultants. Track scope and cost movements across project phases and escalate material changes, risks, opportunities, and non-compliance issues. Apply benchmarking data, cost planning software, digital tools, and cost planning analytics to support the review and validation of cost positions. Support business unit cost planning capability through training, onboarding, guidance, and adoption of Qiddiya ways of working. Contribute to the preparation of cost planning review packs, governance papers, leadership updates, dashboards, and trackers. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 12 years of relevant experience in cost planning. Demonstrated capability at a working level across core managerial, stakeholder, and governance functions. Developing practitioner-level capability in cost planning, benchmarking, consultant coordination, Stage Gate support, and design-to-budget processes. Required Skills and Attributes Reliable and delivery-focused, with strong ownership of assigned tasks. Professional and constructive in reviewing information, raising issues, and supporting cost planning discussions. Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret cost, design, benchmark, and risk information. Clear communicator capable of preparing structured comments, summaries, trackers, and updates. Collaborative and responsive when working with internal stakeholders and external consultants. Adaptable, proactive, and comfortable working in a fast-moving development environment. Committed to continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and strengthening Qiddiya’s cost planning capability. Accountability in Relation to Cost Consultants While external cost consultants may prepare detailed cost plans, estimates, and supporting analyses, Qiddiya retains accountability for the recommended cost planning position. The Senior Manager supports this by coordinating consultant deliverables, reviewing assigned outputs, recording comments and actions, and escalating key cost planning issues to business unit and cost planning leadership for review. The role ensures consultant outputs align with Qiddiya Cost Planning Technical Guidelines, reflect approved briefs and design status, include appropriate assumptions and reconciliations, identify risks and opportunities, and provide reliable support for project and governance decisions.

db9e998d797dedc0.job_title: Senior Project / Cost Controls Engineer (Commercial/ Internal)
db9e998d797dedc0.description: About the Role Parsons Corporation is seeking a Senior Project / Cost Controls Engineer (Commercial/ Internal) to join its team in Makkah, Saudi Arabia, covering both Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role requires over 10 years of experience and focuses on providing comprehensive project controls support across various financial and operational aspects of projects. Role Overview and Responsibilities The Senior Project / Cost Controls Engineer will manage cost, schedule, risk, revenue, margin, cash flow, and change management. The position involves establishing reliable project baselines, converting operational data into accurate forecasts and P&L insights, and supporting timely risk management decisions throughout the project lifecycle. This role operates with a high degree of independence while ensuring compliance with contractual requirements, internal governance, and established project controls processes. Develop and maintain project budgets, cost breakdown structures, and Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), aligning them with scope, schedule, procurement strategy, resource plans, and contractual deliverables. Prepare monthly forecasts including estimate to complete (ETC), estimate at completion (EAC), revenue, gross profit, margin, cash flow, and headcount assumptions, explaining material variances. Track commitments, actual costs, accruals, and forecast costs, identifying unfavorable trends and recommending corrective actions. Apply Earned Value Management (EVM) principles and other performance-measurement techniques to evaluate cost and schedule performance. Support appropriate revenue recognition methods, prepare and validate accruals, and ensure accurate monthly reporting. Interpret contractual and subcontract terms affecting revenue, margin, billing, cash collection, and risk allocation, escalating material commercial exposure. Identify, quantify, document, and track client and internal changes, ensuring reflection in project forecasts, risk registers, budgets, and schedules. Facilitate identification and assessment of project risks and opportunities, maintaining risk registers and monitoring contingency. Interpret payment terms, support accurate invoicing, forecast collections, and monitor accounts receivable and unbilled balances. Interpret project schedules, progress data, critical milestones, and resource requirements, assessing cost and commercial impact of schedule movement. Prepare concise dashboards and management reports covering cost, schedule, revenue, margin, cash, risks, opportunities, and changes. Partner with Project Directors, Project Managers, technical leads, Finance, Commercial, Contracts, and Procurement teams. Reconcile revenue, gross profit, final costs, commitments, and changes during project closeout. Required Skills and Qualifications Candidates must possess a strong foundation in project controls and financial acumen, coupled with analytical and communication abilities. Technical Project Controls: Strong knowledge of cost control, forecasting, budgeting, EVM, change control, risk management, cash flow, and performance reporting. Financial and Commercial Acumen: Ability to understand project P&L, revenue recognition, margin drivers, accruals, working capital, contract terms, and financial consequences of project decisions. Data and Systems: Advanced Microsoft Excel capability and practical experience producing clear Power BI dashboards. Working knowledge of project controls, scheduling, ERP, and cost-management systems is preferred. Analytical Thinking: Ability to interpret complex data, challenge assumptions, identify trends and root causes, and translate analysis into clear actions. Accuracy and Governance: Strong attention to detail, disciplined documentation, and commitment to reliable, auditable, and timely reporting. Communication and Influence: Clear written and verbal communication, with the confidence to explain financial and project-control issues to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Desired Attributes Collaboration: Ability to work effectively across project, technical, commercial, finance, and leadership teams while maintaining constructive challenge and accountability. Prioritization and Adaptability: Ability to manage competing deadlines, respond to changing project conditions, and maintain reporting quality in a demanding environment. Problem-Solving: Practical approach to resolving complex project-controls issues, closing data gaps, and developing proportionate recovery or mitigation actions. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Makkah, Saudi Arabia, with responsibilities extending to projects in Jeddah. The role involves close collaboration with various internal and external stakeholders, requiring a proactive and independent approach to project controls.

Perform and verify power system studies in ETAP: load flow, short circuit, arc flash, motor starting, protection coordination and harmonics. Own protection philosophy and relay settings; review coordination studies and witness relay testing. Specify HV/MV/LV equipment: power transformers, switchgear, MCCs, VFDs, UPS, cables and substations. HV/MV switchgear: GIS and AIS, vacuum circuit breakers, vacuum contactors (F-C), interlocking, CT/VT sizing and saturation effect on protection. Transformer and bus protection: Differential, REF, bus differential, breaker failure, inrush and over-excitation blocking. Motor protection: Thermal model, locked rotor, stall, unbalance, earth fault, starts per hour, RTD inputs. Feeder protection: Overcurrent and earth fault grading, directional elements, auto-reclose where applicable. Large MV motors: Crusher, conveyor, mill and slurry pump drives; DOL, soft starter and VFD starting; IR/PI testing; voltage dip on starting; electrical causes of bearing and vibration faults. Variable frequency drives (MV/LV): Drive topologies, harmonics and filters, bearing currents, motor cable length and dv/dt, cooling and derating in heat and dust. LV distribution: MCCs, ACBs, MCCBs, selectivity between devices, intelligent MCC communication. MV/LV cables: Sizing and derating, MV terminations and joints, VLF, tan delta and partial discharge testing, fault location. Power factor correction: Capacitor banks, detuned reactors, resonance with VFD harmonics. Earthing and lightning: Earthing design and testing in high-resistivity desert soil, step and touch voltage, lightning protection. Control and monitoring: Interface with PLC/DCS, power management system (PMS), load shedding schemes, IEC 61850 substation automation. Substation buildings: HVAC for switchrooms, dust ingress, IP ratings, fire detection and suppression. Hazardous areas: Area classification and Ex equipment (IECEx/ATEX) for fuel storage and other classified areas. Soft skills The candidate must challenge contractors with confidence and explain technical risk to non-electrical managers. Strong technical judgement and ownership of decisions Clear written comments on contractor submittals Works well across Operations, Maintenance and Procurement Calm under shutdown and commissioning pressure Desired Candidate Profile -

db2ecff3a8de55d4.description: About Telnyx Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. We're driven by a desire to transform and modernize what's antiquated, automate the manual, and solve real-world problems through innovative connectivity solutions. As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team. Our collective vision is a world where borderless connectivity fuels limitless innovation. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers. The Role We're building a local Enterprise Sales Pod in Riyadh — one AE and one Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), working together to build a Telnyx enterprise business in your market. You'll embed directly with enterprise customers to architect and ship production systems on Telnyx's global network — voice, messaging, AI, and wireless. This isn't about demoing products. It's about building real solutions that work at scale. You'll work side-by-side with a dedicated Enterprise AE — not a demo resource, but a commercial partner who owns the named-account list, builds executive relationships, and closes the deal. You own the technical side: discovery, architecture, POC, and production go-live. You win together. No throw-over-the-wall. The Pod Model Enterprise AE — owns the named-account list, builds executive relationships, gets in the room, owns commercial qualification and close, expands the account. Forward Deployed Engineer — owns technical discovery, designs the architecture, builds the POC when gated, gets the first workload live, removes blockers and finds the next workload. We sell the workload, not the SKU. Customers buy a production outcome — an AI contact center, a SOC/NOC agent, global communications, connected mobility, or enterprise inference — that runs on Telnyx primitives (voice, messaging, numbers, wireless, Voice AI, inference, agents, connectivity). You lead with the outcome conversation, not a product menu. What You'll Do Embed with enterprise customers to understand their communications workflows, AI use cases, and integration challenges firsthand Build and deploy custom implementations: AI Voice Assistants, Telnyx APIs (Voice, Messaging, Fax, Wireless), WebRTC Run open-weight LLMs in customer environments — consume GLM, Kimi, DeepSeek, Qwen, and MiniMax through Telnyx Inference (OpenAI-compatible API; there's no model infrastructure for you to run), or deploy self-hosted stacks (Llama, Mistral, and region-specific models like Jais, ALLaM, or other Arabic-language sovereign models) behind your own serving engine when air-gapped or sovereign-cloud requirements demand it Deploy and operate LiteLLM as the model gateway in customer environments: a unified OpenAI-compatible interface across self-hosted open-weight models and hosted providers, with routing, load balancing, retries and fallbacks, rate limits, and per-team virtual keys Instrument and govern LLM usage through the gateway — cost tracking and budgets, caching, logging and observability (OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, or similar), and guardrails — so customers can see and control what their AI workloads are doing Wire production observability for everything you ship — metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and alerting (e.g. Prometheus + Grafana for metrics, OpenTelemetry for traces, Graylog or ELK for logs — or the customer's existing stack) — so you and the customer's ops team both know what "healthy" looks like and what pages whom when it isn't Design model routing strategies for real-time voice workloads, balancing latency, cost, and quality, with sane fallback behavior when a provider degrades Make the build-vs-buy case between self-hosted open-weight models and hosted frontier APIs, and keep the customer's application code portable across both Adapt models to customer domains: prompt and RAG pipelines and evaluation harnesses for Arabic and English language use cases and KSA/GCC-specific regulatory environments (PDPL, Saudi data localization, cloud sovereignty requirements) Lead POCs, pilots, and production launches from whiteboard to go-live Own customer outcomes — stay engaged until the solution is live and stable Collaborate directly with Product and Engineering to shape the roadmap based on field insights from Saudi Arabia and the broader GCC Create clear technical documentation, runbooks, and maintainable solutions for handoff Troubleshoot and resolve complex integration issues alongside customer teams What We're Looking For CS degree or equivalent experience 3+ years building and shipping production software — you've written code that real users depended on, you've been on-call for it, and you've debugged it when things broke. (A consulting background counts if this is also true of you.) Proficiency in multiple languages: Python, Node.js/TypeScript, Go — you're more dangerous in some than others. (Telnyx Edge Compute — functions and stateful actors — is TypeScript, so that one pulls double duty.) Practical understanding of what breaks in front of a model in production: provider rate limits and quotas, timeout and retry behavior, streaming, token accounting and cost attribution, and the failure modes that only show up under concurrency Comfortable deploying containerized services on Kubernetes, with secrets management, config, and upgrades as part of the deployment story You've wired observability and been paged because of it — Prometheus + Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Graylog, ELK, or equivalent. You know what to monitor, what to alert on, and what "healthy" looks like High-concurrency experience — Kafka, message queues, or event streams at real scale. When throughput spikes you know what breaks — consumer lag, backpressure, hot partitions, rebalance stalls — and what absorbs it: partitioning, consumer groups, parallelism up to your partition count You've built APIs from scratch, not just consumed them — OpenAPI spec, REST/GraphQL design, auth, rate limiting, versioning, idempotency Event-driven thinking and cloud-native instincts Exposure to SIP, WebRTC, or real-time voice/messaging systems Self-sufficient by default — there's no engineering team behind you. You read the code and the docs, ask the customer (not your manager), and make sound engineering judgment calls on your own Customer-facing engineering experience — you can run discovery with a customer's engineers and present to their executives in the same week Ability to translate "it's not working" into root cause Comfortable working on customer sites and in high-stakes technical conversations Excellent written and verbal communication in English and Arabic. You can run whiteboard sessions, live troubleshooting, and escalations with customer engineering teams. Based in Riyadh, or willing to relocate — this is a hybrid role with travel across the Kingdom and broader GCC Legally authorized to work in Saudi Arabia, or eligible for sponsorship Bonus Points For Experience with AI voice assistants, STT/TTS, or LLM-based conversational systems Building eval sets for a specific domain Hands-on production experience with an LLM gateway — LiteLLM, Portkey, Kong AI Gateway, or an in-house OpenAI-compatible proxy — including config-driven model definitions, routing and fallback rules, and virtual key management Familiarity with the open-weight model landscape and the trade-offs

dbf4d4283420aa40.description: Eram Talent is searching for a Finance & Revenue Cycle Management Specialist to join our team in Saudi Arabia. This role is essential in ensuring the effective financial management of the organization's revenue cycle processes. The specialist will be responsible for analyzing financial data, optimizing revenue streams, and ensuring compliance with financial regulations and policies. This role is crucial in ensuring the accurate, timely, and transparent validation of invoices, quotations, and insurance claims across all providers and insurers. The position requires close coordination with the operator, insurers, and internal finance teams to ensure compliance, reduce rejections, and improve financial sustainability. Responsibilities Financial Oversight: Review and validate all invoices submitted by the operator for accuracy and compliance. Review and validate quotations for services and ensure alignment with agreed contractual terms. Collaborate with Finance and KAUST leadership on budget adherence, forecasting, and expenditure control. Lead the preparation, monitoring, and control of annual budgets in alignment with KAUST Health's strategic and operational goals. Provide monthly financial analysis and variance reports with recommendations for corrective actions. Insurance & Revenue Cycle Management: Oversee the monthly insurance claim submission process across all insurance companies. Validate claim accuracy, completeness, and compliance with insurance requirements. Monitor rejection rates and develop action plans to reduce claim denials and improve collection timelines. Lead reconciliation meetings with the operator and insurers to resolve discrepancies. Ensure transparency and accountability in claim and payment processes. Reporting & Analysis: Provide regular financial and insurance claim performance reports to senior leadership. Track KPIs related to financial and revenue cycle performance. identify risks and opportunities for revenue optimization. Work closely with the Head of Health, Operations Manager, and Finance department to ensure alignment of financial and operational objectives. Support audits and ensure compliance with internal and external financial regulations. Bachelor’s degree (required) in Finance or Accounting (preferred). Master’s degree in Finance (preferred). Professional certifications (e.g., CPA, CMA) are an advantage. Minimum 6 years of experience, with at least 3 years in a lead role. Proven experience in the healthcare sector finance, insurance, or revenue cycle management. Strong background in financial analysis, budgeting, and reporting. Hands-on experience with insurance claim processes, validation, and reconciliation. Demonstrated experience in preparing, managing, and monitoring budgets within a healthcare environment.
